CA.rationale: Content (red locations) and processing provenance (origin) are both explicitly bound for the same p0/current/n0 item.

COD.rationale: The report identifies content (red locations), states how it is presented (explicit coordinate set), and separately provides its origin/provenance for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Origin/provenance entries (functional processing descriptors) are explicitly linked to the same content item (red locations), indicating processing/derivation of that content.

C.rationale: The report explicitly names contents (red, blue) and provides their coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Separate origin/provenance fields distinguish the content identity (color/locations) from its status/derivation.

O.rationale: Content is presented as explicit coordinate sets (pattern organization) for the named items.
